date_check: DATE CHECK - Every story is dated Saturday 21 Nov 2026. Friday-night events count only when the announcement, bulletin or toll update came Saturday: Chapo Isidro (arrested Fri, announced Sat), Peru quake (19:09 Fri local = 00:09 Sat UTC), Kryvyi Rih toll, Nigeria toll of 24, Bolsonaro ICU bulletin, Denmark charge, Rikers plan, Harden game.
